description: Golden Q&A dataset for RAG evaluation. Expand to 50+ pairs for meaningful metrics.

questions.question: What is the purpose of this system?
questions.ground_truth: This system is a RAG-based AI chatbot that answers questions from private documents using retrieval-augmented generation.

questions.question: What document formats are supported?
questions.ground_truth: The system supports PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, and HTML document formats.

questions.question: How does the retrieval pipeline work?
questions.ground_truth: The retrieval pipeline uses hybrid search combining BM25 full-text search with vector similarity search, merges results via Reciprocal Rank Fusion, then reranks with a cross-encoder model.

questions.question: What embedding model is used?
questions.ground_truth: BGE-M3 is used for embeddings, producing both dense (1024-dim) and sparse vectors in a single forward pass.

questions.question: How are documents chunked?
questions.ground_truth: Documents are chunked using recursive character splitting with a default size of 512 tokens and 10% overlap.
